attachments.title: <https://github.com/nvim-treesitter/nvim-treesitter/issues/1136|#1136 Invalid indents for python>
attachments.text:
*Describe the bug*

Indents not working as expected, here is example:

```
class Foo:# Enter
▌# cursor is here
```

Expected result

```
class Foo:# Enter
    ▌# cursor is here
```

Same with `def function`

```
def function():# Enter
▌# cursor is here
```

But must have 4 spaces indent.

Apparently, if file has an extra newline, following current line like this:

```
class Foo:# Enter
    ▌# cursor is here
# This empty line must exist for indent to work.
```

It works fine.
